title: Do net1's beliefs keep what tells copies from a stock competitor?
description: Round 18's copies belief q mistakes Cubic for copies, so a net2 that cooperates with copies yields to Cubic (exp-net2-eval-v6-coop-176). This asks whether net1's output keeps the information to tell them apart. The fixed rule on net1 v6 (u = 0.25) runs as the observed flow on the validation links (campaign seed 11, 30 s) alone, under random loss, against stock competitors (the new family: Cubic from 0 s, BBRv1 from 4 s, Cubic from 2 s and 10 s; the held-out competitors: BBRv3, Westwood) and as 2 and 4 copies, with the observations kept. experiments/competitor_info.py then trains one per-step classifier of the other traffic (none, copies, a stock TCP flow) on the raw measurements net1 reads and one on net1 v6's beliefs, and scores each on links it never saw (3 folds by link). A gap between them is what the LCFs omit (H1's failure mode).
prepare: N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for f in new held-competitors; do uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$f" --split val --family "$f" --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$f/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$f"; done; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 1 2 4 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
